verdict.rationale: Fivetran's docs make one thin first-party claim that it can create a unified context layer for AI tools, and it lists Unstructured File Replication as a feature. Otherwise, its documented destinations are warehouses and data lakes in open table formats, with no named vector-store destination. Missing for 10: documented vector-store destinations, embedding/chunking into LLM-ready formats, details of how agents retrieve synced data, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, pipelines load into vector stores and LLM-ready formats so my agents can retrieve what was synced

citations.quote: Create a unified context layer that enables your AI tools to answer questions more accurately.
